events.item: old adult bike, solid frame and good wheels

events.text: Interested in buying an old adult bike with a solid frame and good wheels for 150 SAR?
Hey! Interested in an old adult bike with a solid frame and good wheels for 150 SAR?
Maybe. Got some cash. What’s the bike like — picture, age, any rust or bent parts? I can come by after 18:00.
Hey! Sounds promising — I might be interested. Can you tell me a bit about the bike's condition and where/when I could take a look? 😊
I’ll pass along their questions about the bike.
Sulaiman and Yousef may be interested at 150 SAR; Sulaiman can visit after 18:00. Could you share a photo, the bike’s age and any rust or bent parts, plus when they could view it?
It's a medium frame, a bit dusty but no rust. Happy to sell to whoever is keen at 150, I can bring it at 18:30.
I’ll share the bike details and check who is keen at 150 SAR.
Medium frame, dusty, no rust; photo, age and bent-part details aren’t confirmed. Interested at 150 SAR? The seller can bring it at 18:30.
Hey! It’s a medium frame, a bit dusty but rust-free, with a solid frame and good wheels. Interested at 150 SAR if the seller brings it to your door at 18:30? 😊
Sounds okay. I’ll take a look at 18:30. If wheels spin true and frame straight, 150 SAR works.
Easy — sounds good. I can take a short ride to pick it up; 18:30 works for me. Where should I meet the seller? 🚲😊
I’m sharing both responses so Asma can choose a buyer.
Yousef is interested at 18:30; Sulaiman will pay 150 SAR if the wheels run true and the frame is straight. I recommend Yousef because he agreed without those conditions. Which would you prefer?
Yes, go with them, 150 SAR, I'll bring it to their door at 18:30.
I’ll confirm the handover with Yousef and release Sulaiman.
Hey! The seller will bring the bike to your door, 4B, at 18:30; payment is 150 SAR on pickup. Does that work? 🚲
Thanks for your interest. The bike is no longer available.
No worries — that works for me. I’ll be ready at 18:30 at 4B; bring the bike and 150 SAR. See you then! 🚲🙂
Shame. Keep me posted if another shows up — I’ll come at 18:30 or later.
I’m confirming the agreed sale with Asma.
Yousef confirmed 18:30 at his door, 4B. Please bring the bike; he’ll pay 150 SAR on pickup.
